summary: Validated CSS fix for mobile bottom tabbar visibility & desktop hiding across viewports 1920x800 and 390x800 for Novaro SPA. Both viewports pass. Backend /api/health sanity also passes.
critical_code_review_comments: index.html is a very large single inline file (>1600 lines); consider splitting CSS/JS out for maintainability (non-blocking).
Regression risk high due to monolithic file — recommend adding a lightweight CSS snapshot test to guard the @media (max-width:640px) block that was previously lost.
test_credentials: Demo login via #demoBtn (no code needed); access codes 101-120 also valid.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SPA persists login in localStorage; when re-navigating to /app mobile viewport, clear localStorage first or the #demoBtn will not be visible. Tour card (.tour-card) shows after demo login on both viewports — close via .tour-close before measuring layout.
rca of the issue: Prior bug: base CSS `.tabbar{display:none}` had a missing `@media (max-width:640px){.tabbar{display:grid;...}}` wrapper causing tabbar to render on desktop and grids to overflow at 390px. CSS-only fix restored the media query wrapper. Verified via computed styles: desktop display=none, mobile display=grid position=fixed bottom=0px, and scrollWidth==390 on all mobile pages tested.
